in_latin.name: Marcelle
in_latin.meaning: Marcelle means young, devoted to Mars

The name may also be associated with the Hebrew name 'Marcella,' which means 'bitter.' In Christian tradition, Marcelle symbolizes renewal, faith, and resilience.
